turns.text: 2:45 am update. typing one-handed sorry. two things, can you edit both? first is a message from a mom i met at thursday baby story time at the library (we go every thursday 10:30). she wrote: "Hey Elliot! Was great seeing you and Theo today. Quick q, did you ever get a daycare sorted? We're stuck on two waitlists and I'm losing it. Any tips?" my draft reply: "hey! yes finally, Theo has a spot at Little Egrets Learning Center on Pell Road starting Jan 5. honestly just kept calling every week and it paid off. happy to compare notes, story time tomorrow?" please keep it friendly, not braggy

Your draft is already warm. A few light tweaks to soften the "finally" and make it feel less braggy:

"Hey! Great seeing you two too. We did get lucky: Theo has a spot at Little Egrets Learning Center on Pell Road starting Jan 5. Honestly, I just kept calling every week and it eventually paid off, so don't give up on those waitlists. Happy to compare notes at story time tomorrow if you want!"

One thing: you wrote "tomorrow," and since it's already past midnight, make sure that matches the day you mean. Want it shorter?

good catch, thursday is today technically lol. change to "later today". second one: 211 taped another note to the door. it says the crying at night is "unacceptable and I will be contacting management." here's my reply:

"Hi Walter, thanks for your note. Babies cry, and we're doing everything we can to help Theo sleep. We're not able to guarantee silence, but we're happy to talk anytime. Elliot, 209"

is it too sharp? i didn't put a sorry in it. is that fine?

Updated first reply with "later today":

"Hey! Great seeing you two too. We did get lucky: Theo has a spot at Little Egrets Learning Center on Pell Road starting Jan 5. Honestly, I just kept calling every week and it eventually paid off, so don't give up on those waitlists. Happy to compare notes at story time later today if you want!"

As for the note to your neighbor: it's not too sharp. It's polite, clear and offers a conversation, and an apology isn't needed for normal baby noise. If you want it a touch warmer without backing down:

"Hi Walter, thanks for your note. Babies cry, and we're doing everything we can to help Theo sleep. We can't promise complete quiet, but we're glad to talk anytime. Thanks for understanding. Elliot, 209"

Either version works. Mine just adds a small courteous closer.
thanks, going with the second one. scoreboard: dad 1, neighbor 0. 🙃
Nice work. Both messages are ready to send. Get some sleep if the baby lets you!
